{
  "name": "flow",
  "version": "0.5.5",
  "author": {
    "name": "stanvx",
    "url": "https://github.com/stanvx"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/stanvx/flow-stack",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/stanvx/flow-stack",
  "description": "Tracks a task through Matt Pocock's idea-to-ship flow, shows the next step above the prompt, and holds a build until its checks prove it.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "dependencies": [
    "mattpocock-skills",
    "ponytail",
    "typesafe"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "autoAdvance": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Auto-advance after approval",
      "description": "After /flow approve, and when the model reports a build or closing stage finished (implement, implement-spec, diagnosing-bugs, pr, push), run the next stage at once instead of showing it. Planning never starts a build, a gate waits for you unless Jev waived it (a waived spec leads on to the tickets), and a full context stops it.",
      "default": false
    },
    "clearAt": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Context nudge (%)",
      "description": "From this share of the context window, the band and each gate suggest /clear before the next stage.",
      "default": 50
    },
    "checks": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extra check commands",
      "description": "Comma-separated text that marks a Bash command as a check the proof gate counts, beside the test, lint and typecheck runners it already knows: scripts/ci.sh, make smoke.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "planModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Plan model",
      "description": "What a new task's planning stages run on unless you pick otherwise. session keeps the build model; a name runs the family's latest.",
      "options": [
        "session",
        "fable",
        "opus",
        "sonnet",
        "haiku"
      ],
      "default": "session"
    },
    "buildModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Build model",
      "description": "What a new task's other stages run on unless you pick otherwise. session keeps the session's model; a name runs the family's latest.",
      "options": [
        "session",
        "fable",
        "opus",
        "sonnet",
        "haiku"
      ],
      "default": "session"
    },
    "helpers": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Helper agents",
      "description": "What a new task's built-in helper agents (Explore, general-purpose, Plan) run on: own (their own model), stage (the model of the stage under way), or one model throughout.",
      "options": [
        "own",
        "stage",
        "fable",
        "opus",
        "sonnet",
        "haiku"
      ],
      "default": "own"
    },
    "critic": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Second look",
      "description": "Before a new task's build stage is recorded finished, a fork of the session (sharing its prompt cache) names the one thing most likely missed, and the model answers it first. Once per stage.",
      "default": false
    },
    "criticPanel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Second look, second model",
      "description": "With the second look on, also ask this model to review the change (the git diff against the branch base, not the conversation) and judge the fork's finding. A finding both stand behind holds the stage; one only one of them raised is kept as a note for the retro. off keeps the fork alone, which holds on its own finding.",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "fable",
        "opus",
        "sonnet",
        "haiku"
      ],
      "default": "off"
    },
    "rules": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "House rules file",
      "description": "A file (repo-relative or absolute) appended to every stage skill as it loads, for a new task: your conventions and tooling, so a skill is adapted without forking it. They win over the skill where they disagree.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "jevMode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Jev judgments",
      "description": "off: never call Jev. shadow: Jev reads each prompt for rework and each build turn's end for evidence, and only logs (/flow jev). on: a rework prompt also carries a note for the model, short evidence keeps the band from reading Ready, and a block Jev is sure is needless is waived (a spec or tickets gate, a prototype edit in planning, a missing check in a task that never ran one). Shadow also logs what it would waive. Sends clipped prompt, reply, gate document and edit text to TypeSafe.",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "shadow",
        "on"
      ],
      "default": "off"
    },
    "jevApiKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeSafe API key",
      "description": "The key Jev calls use. Empty reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.",
      "sensitive": true
    },
    "jevBaseUrl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Jev base URL",
      "description": "Where /v1/systemone is served: TypeSafe's API, or a gateway that passes it through.",
      "default": "https://api.typesafe.ai"
    },
    "jevModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Jev model",
      "description": "Pinned on purpose: the thresholds were set against this version.",
      "default": "jev-1.13.0"
    },
    "ponytail": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ponytail",
      "description": "Pick how hard the build stages (implement, implement-spec, diagnosing-bugs) push for the smallest change that works: lite, full or ultra are ponytail's own intensity levels, lite the lightest. Planning stages are unchanged. off adds nothing here, though ponytail's own hooks still act if you enabled them.",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "lite",
        "full",
        "ultra"
      ],
      "default": "off"
    }
  },
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "workflow",
    "verification",
    "proof",
    "tdd",
    "claude-code",
    "hooks"
  ]
}
